blurb: Guests can book full day, half day, marathon, custom, tuna & shark, or evening sunset cruise trips. Trips include fishing for various species, whale watching, and sightseeing. Trips accommodate 1-6 people depending on the offering.
extraNote: Deposit required at booking; non-refundable if cancelled within two weeks of trip · Deposit refundable if cancelled beyond two weeks · Deposits fully refundable or transferable if trip cancelled due to bad weather · Fuel surcharge may apply due to fuel cost fluctuations · 20% gratuity customary if a mate is present or requested · Trips may be cancelled for safety or weather reasons
